rule: Before launch and ready on 10-20: on their phone a shopper fills in what they can (name, phone, email) and takes their photo. At the register they show a driver's license or other photo ID and sign the screen; staff check the ID against the photo and scan a card. Until then the sign-up is "not ready" (J2).
title: Joining from a phone
words: Start your Thrift+ card on your phone, then finish at any register in a minute.
